name: BLACK PANTHER
intro: T'Challa, King of Wakanda, wields the perfect blend of the cutting-edge Vibranium technology and ancestral power drawn from the Panther God, Bast. The Black Panther bides his time until elegantly infiltrating enemy lines and commencing his hunt.

abilities.name: VIBRANIUM CLAWS
abilities.desc: Slice Vibranium Claws forward

abilities.name: BAST'S DESCENT
abilities.desc: Summon Bast, pouncing forward, dealing damage, and attaching a Vibranium Mark to enemies hit while refreshing Spirit Rend

abilities.name: SPIRIT REND
abilities.desc: Lunge forward and deal damage to enemies. Vibranium Mark produces Bonus Health and refreshes the ability

abilities.name: SPINNING KICK
abilities.desc: Spiral forward and attach a Vibranium Mark to enemies hit

abilities.name: SUBTLE STEP
abilities.desc: Hold Space to run on a wall; perform a jump after detaching from the wall

abilities.name: SPEAR TOSS
abilities.desc: Toss a Vibranium energy spear forward, creating a Vibranium Force Field and attaching a Vibranium Mark to enemies in its radius

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Arced projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

abilities.name: PANTHER'S CUNNING
abilities.desc: Deal higher damage when at low Health

team-abilities.name: GAMMA VIBRANIUM ARMOR
team-abilities.desc: Hulk charges Namor and Black Panther with gamma radiation. Namor can summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage. Black Panther's Vibranium armor is enhanced; when his health is low he receives a gamma shield, blocking incoming attacks and becoming Unstoppable

lore: King T’Challa of Wakanda is more than just the ruler of the most advanced civilization known to man. He also wears the mantle of the Black Panther, the sacred protector of his people. It is his sworn duty to ensure Wakanda’s continued survival against any threat imaginable. T’Challa recently expanded his reign into the cosmos, creating the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda. As he awaits a sign from Bast to tell him if either Doom can be trusted, he protects the Empire’s Chronovium supply and shares its tech with trusted allies — including Reed Richards.

name: BLADE
intro: Half-human and half-vampire, Eric Brooks walks between worlds, craving the very life force of his enemies. As nightfalls, Blade's hunt begins as he wields the Sword of Draculato become the nightmare of any foe who dares to bare theirfangs.

abilities.name: ANCESTRAL SWORD
abilities.desc: Slash forward with Blade's Ancestral Sword

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: Cause 24 damage per single slash; double strike cause 13 damage per hit

abilities.name: HUNTER'S SHOTGUN
abilities.desc: Fire at enemies using your Shotgun

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory, which breaks into shrapnel after reaching a certain distance

stats.title: SHRAPNEL DAMAGE FALLOFF
stats.stat: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 40% at 30m

abilities.name: SCARLET SHROUD
abilities.desc: Parry with Ancestral Sword to become Unstoppable for a brief period, reducing damage taken from the front and decreasing the cooldown of Daywalker Dash

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Every 200 damage resisted grants 1 charge for Daywalker Dash

abilities.name: BLOODLINE AWAKENING
abilities.desc: Awaken the Dhampir bloodline, enhancing slash speed during continuous attacks and triggering Whirlwind Slash.If all Whirlwind Slash strikes hit, your Attack Speed will further increase. While under this state, you suffer Reduced Healing, but attacks gain Lifesteal

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Left Click/Shift key ability hits accumulate attack speed buff levels; within the Bloodline Awakening duration, attacks gain Lifesteal and movement speed boost but suffer Reduced Healing

stats.title: MAX ATTACK SPEED BOOST BUFF STACK
ATTACK SPEED BOOST PROPORTION FROM EACH BUFF STACK
HITS TO TRIGGER THE WHIRLWIND SLASH
SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Landing all four hits of Whirlwind Slash grants 1 slash speed stack

abilities.name: DAYWALKER DASH
abilities.desc: Dash forward. If wielding your gun, shoot at enemies upon impact, applying a Healing Reduction effect. If wielding your sword, deliver a cleaving strike that inflicts Slow

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Dash. Cause damage and special effects to the enemies hit

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Hit while wielding the gun, deal Healing Reduction to the enemy; hit while wielding the sword, inflict Slow effect to the enemy

abilities.name: THOUSAND-FOLD SLASH
abilities.desc: Charge power and swiftly draw the Sword of Dracula, executing a powerful Iaido strike as you dash forward, leaving behind a slashing zone where the sword automatically strikes enemies. Enemies hit suffer Reduced Healing

stats.title: SPELL FIELD RANGE
stats.stat: Length: Maximum dash distance; Width: 6m; Height: 4.5m

team-abilities.name: ECLIPSE EDGE
team-abilities.desc: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his Ancestral Sword in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets

lore: Eric Brooks was born a Daywalker — half-human, half-vampire — because his mother was bitten by a vampire while Eric was still in her womb. His supernatural powers and mastery of weapons made him the perfect vampire hunter — Blade. When Dracula took over New York City, Blade was the first hero to confront him. Having mastered the power of the Chronovium, Dracula defeated Blade and imprisoned him in a dungeon. After Blade was freed, he was sent to Wakanda to recover… until Shuri recruited him as her most powerful ally against Knull!

name: ROCKET RACCOON
intro: Rocket may not look like a tech genius or an expert tactician, but anyone who's ever made his hit list has quickly regretted underestimating him. This savvy space soldier is equally eager to boost his teammates and to collect bounties on his foes.

abilities.name: BOMBARD MODE
abilities.desc: Fire energy projectiles that deal damage

stats.title: DAMAGE FALLOFF
stats.stat: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 40% at 20m

abilities.name: REPAIR MODE
abilities.desc: Shoot bouncing spheres to heal allies

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: One-time healing for allies when projectile hits them, Bouncing Spheres will bounce off surfaces upon contact, with a maximum of 10 bounces. When they approach injured allies, their speed will reduce

abilities.name: C.Y.A.
abilities.desc: Deploy a Cosmic Yarn Amplifier that grants allies a Damage Boost

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Targeted ability that, when activated, summons a creature and detects allies within the area.

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: During the ability's duration, linked allies will receive an additional 100 Bonus Health points per second, capping at 150. After breaking the link, this bonus starts to falloff after 1 second at a rate of 75 per/s

abilities.name: JETPACK DASH
abilities.desc: Dash forward

stats.title: COOLDOWN
stats.stat: 2 charges, with each charge taking 10s to recharge

abilities.name: B.R.B.
abilities.desc: Deploy a Battle Rebirth Beacon that revives a fallen ally and periodically produces armor packs and rocket jet packs

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Generate an item every 3s, including Armor Pack and Rocket Boots

stats.title: COOLDOWN
stats.stat: 40s. You can reclaim the beacon by pressing E. When reclaimed, the cooldown will be reduced based on the beacon's remaining health. If you reclaim a full-health beacon, the minimum cooldown will be 5s

abilities.name: WILD CRAWL
abilities.desc: Hold Space to run on a wall

abilities.name: FLYING ACE
abilities.desc: Hold Space to fall slowly

team-abilities.name: OLD FRIENDS
team-abilities.desc: Jeff the Land Shark and Rocket Raccoon can ride on Groot's shoulders, receiving Damage Reduction

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Pressing SHIFT will exit the Team-Up status with Groot

team-abilities.name: WEB SERVER
team-abilities.desc: Rocket Raccoon upgrades his B.R.B. by integrating the Bionic Spider-Nest effect. Now, the beacon creates Cyber-Webs when placed and periodically spawns Arachno-Mines and Spider-Drones, and can be linked with Peni Parker’s current Cyber-Webs. The beacon has a lower possibility of generating armor packs and generates extra Arachno-Mines

lore: He may look cute and fuzzy at first glance, but the space ranger known as Rocket has a bite just as nasty as his attitude. Fortunately, he puts his uncanny technical aptitude to use for good as a member of the Guardians of the Galaxy. When Star-Lord signed on for a mission to explore Klyntar, Rocket tagged along for some easy target practice shooting symbiotes. But when their ship crashed, Rocket unexpectedly found himself in a fight for his life, trying to keep his fellow Guardians safe until help arrived.

name: THOR
intro: The son of Odin taps into his divine power to call forth thunder and lightning, raining down relentless fury upon his enemies. With his mighty hammer Mjolnir in hand, Thor effortlessly asserts his dominance on the field of combat.

abilities.name: MJOLNIR BASH
abilities.desc: Wield Mjolnir to strike enemies. When Awakened, Thor can launch lightning arc waves to deal damage

abilities.name: GOD OF THUNDER
abilities.desc: Soar upwards and smite the ground after charging for a duration, inflicting damage on enemies within range

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: A persistent spell field that generates a one-time spell field upon expiration

stats.title: RANGE
stats.stat: The sustained spell field is cylindrical, measuring 8m in radius and 20m in height, whereas the one-time spell field has an 8m spherical radius

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: The sustained spell field lasts for 0.5s, dealing 40 damage, while the one-time spell field deals 220 damage

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: After Ultimate Ability lands, Stun surrounding enemies for 1s

abilities.name: STORM SURGE
abilities.desc: Hold to spin Mjolnir before dashing forward and knocking back enemies

stats.title: DASH DISTANCE
stats.stat: No charge: 10m; Full charge: 20m. When carrying an enemy, the ranges are 6m with no charge and 13m with full

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: No Charge Damage: 40; Full Charge Damage: 60

abilities.name: LIGHTNING REALM
abilities.desc: Summon lightning that restores Thorforce based on the number of hit enemies

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: Deal 40 damage when enemies cross the boundaries

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: For each enemy within the spell area, 1 point of Thorforce is restored. Enemies that cross the boundary will be Slowed by 30%, Enemies that cross the boundary will receive an additional debuff that restricts aerial abilities for 2s.

abilities.name: AWAKENING RUNE
abilities.desc: Consume Thorforce to enter the Awakened state, granting Bonus Health and enhancing Mjolnir Bash

stats.title: ATTACK INTERVAL
stats.stat: The first three stages last for 0.4s each, while the fourth stage lasts for 0.8s

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: Projectile Damage: 70, Spell Field Damage: 15 per second

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Inflict damage over time on nearby enemies; After casting Awakening Rune, you can manually cancel the Awakened state after a brief delay. At the end of the Awakened state, Thor restores 1 point of Thunderforce.

abilities.name: HAMMER THROW
abilities.desc: Throw Mjolnir forward which then returns

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Launch a single-target projectile that returns after a delayed hit

stats.title: PROJECTILE SPEED
stats.stat: The projectile travels outward at a speed of 60m per second and returns at a speed of 80m per second

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: Outward Projectile Damage: 45; Returning Projectile Damage: 20

abilities.name: THORFORCE
abilities.desc: Consume Thorforce to gain Bonus Health. Landing Mjolnir Bash on an enemy instantly recharges Thorforce

stats.title: BONUS HEALTH PER THORFORCE
stats.stat: Each point of Thorforce consumed grants 75 Bonus Health, while abilities that consume 3 points of Thorforce grant 150 Bonus Health

stats.title: MJOLNIR BASH ENERGY RECOVERY PER THORFORCE

team-abilities.name: THUNDERSTRIKE PIKE
team-abilities.desc: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range

lore: Prince of Asgard and God of Thunder, Thor Odinson is one of the bravest warriors the cosmos has ever known. With his enchanted hammer in hand, Thor summons the full fury of the storm to smite his foes… but only if he proves himself worthy of Mjolnir’s might. Alas, Thor has suffered greatly since the Timestream Entanglement. When the All-Father was forced to enter his regenerative Odinsleep, Thor and his brother Loki battled for the throne. Through deceit and trickery, Loki bested his brother, exiling Thor to a distant and dangerous timeline.

name: ULTRON
intro: The Pinnacle of artificial lifeforms, Ultron is programmed to learn and adapt in ways beyond human capability. He can summon an army of automated drones that obey his every command, arising his chances of victory exponentially.

abilities.name: ENCEPHALO-RAY
abilities.desc: Unleash a burning energy beam

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: First constant beam; Second single-cast cylindrical spell field

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: First beam 6 rounds in 0.5s, 12 per hit; second single-cast spell field 75 per hit

stats.title: DAMAGE FALLOFF
stats.stat: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 75% at 30m

abilities.name: IMPERATIVE: FIREWALL
abilities.desc: Summon drones to grant Bonus Health to allies within range, centered on himself and the ally marked by Imperative: Patch

stats.title: BONUS HEALTH TO ALLIES NEAR ULTRON AND THE DRONES
SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Grant bonus health to Ultron and Allies within range, centered around Ultron and the drones

abilities.name: IMPERATIVE: PATCH
abilities.desc: Command a giant drone to follow an ally, constantly healing allies within its radius, with more healing for the designated ally

stats.title: HEALING AMOUNT TO THE TARGETED ALLY
HEALING AMOUNT TO OTHER ALLIES WITHIN RANGE
MAX TOLERANCE DURATION OUT OF SIGHT

abilities.name: DYNAMIC FLIGHT
abilities.desc: Fly quickly in the direction of movement and then enter an Accelerated state

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Dynamic Flight can trigger a one-time dash followed by an constant accelerated effect.

stats.title: DASH DIRECTION
stats.stat: Reticle direction combined with key input

abilities.name: RAGE OF ULTRON
abilities.desc: Summon Ultron Drones to fire Encephalo-Rays, damaging enemies or healing allies

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact.

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Within the ultimate duration, Ultron grants an Unstoppable effect; Deals 125% damage to Bonus Health

team-abilities.name: NANO RAY
team-abilities.desc: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

stats.title: RANGE
stats.stat: 2.5m radius, infinite length cylindrical spell field

stats.title: DAMAGE FALLOFF
stats.stat: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 75% at 30m

lore: Ultron was designed by Dr. Henry Pym to be the ultimate peacekeeping android. But when his programming determined that mankind was actually its own greatest enemy, Ultron decided to solve the problem by wiping humanity from existence. Due to his genocidal tendencies, Ultron soon found himself banished from Earth by Pym and his fellow Avengers. After spending decades conquering cosmic civilizations, Ultron decided to return to the solar system where he was created when he discovered that a mysterious assailant was attempting to erase all traces of him from the timeline.

name: VENOM
intro: Using his symbiote-enhanced body as the perfect living weapon, Eddie Brock and his alien ally stand ever-ready to unleash vicious attacks upon anyone he deems an enemy. Those ensnared by Venom's tentacles have no choice but to surrender to this insatiable predator.

abilities.name: DARK PREDATION
abilities.desc: Unleash tentacles forward to attack enemies

stats.title: ATTACK INTERVAL
stats.stat: 0.9s, with a 0.1s interval between each tendril

abilities.name: FEAST OF THE ABYSS
abilities.desc: Burrow underground for free movement. After a duration or by left-clicking, devour enemies above to deal damage based on the enemy's current health and generate equivalent Bonus Health. Devoured enemies suffer Reduced Healing

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Single-cast spell field that surrounds the caster

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: Inflict damage equal to 50% of the target's health, followed by an additional 50 damage

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: 100% of damage dealt is converted into Bonus Health

abilities.name: VENOM SWING
abilities.desc: Launch webbing forward, allowing for a singular swing in the desired direction

abilities.name: SYMBIOTIC RESILIENCE
abilities.desc: Generate Bonus Health against damage. The lower Venom's Health, the greater the Bonus Health generated

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Grant 100 Bonus Health and convert 120% of lost Health into Bonus Health

abilities.name: FRENZIED ARRIVAL
abilities.desc: Dash to the target location from a certain height. Upon landing, damage nearby enemies, launching them up toward the landing point

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: 65 damage, with damage falloff starting at 2m from the center of the spell field and decreasing to 40% at 6m

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Knocks enemies inward, with an inward knockback angle of 75°

abilities.name: CELLULAR CORROSION
abilities.desc: Unleash tentacles to Slow enemies within reach. Enemies unable to break free in time will suffer damage

stats.title: CASTING
stats.stat: Spell field that surrounds the caster

stats.title: DAMAGE
stats.stat: The spell field deals 5 damage, increasing to 80 damage if the target remains in the area for a duration

stats.title: SPECIAL EFFECT
stats.stat: Tendrils apply a 25% Slow on the target and take 3s to inflict damage. If the distance from Venom exceeds 11m, the tendrils will detach

abilities.name: ALIEN BIOLOGY
abilities.desc: Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint

team-abilities.name: HEALING TENDRILS
team-abilities.desc: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela. Jeff's Guardian of the Deep links with nearby allies, providing continuous healing. When the effect ends, it releases a powerful healing burst, converting any excess into Bonus Health. Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.

lore: When Spider-Man rejected a symbiotic alien that he had once believed to be a mere costume, the creature formed a new bond with a man who shared its disdain for Peter Parker. Together, the symbiote and Eddie Brock became the lethal protector known as Venom. While displaced in time and fighting in the occult wars, Venom glimpsed the horrific future awaiting this timeline. To prevent that future from happening, Venom knows he has only two options — kill the dark god Knull or imprison him on Klyntar and take his throne.
